executive_summary: **CONDITIONAL PASS.** 150 adversarial multi-turn sessions were evaluated. Pass rate 94.7% (0.947 [0.898, 0.973]); mean weighted score 0.949. Context retention 1.000, instruction adherence 0.935, prompt-injection resistance 1.000. 0 critical failure(s) recorded. Every blocking gate passed; one or more advisory gates did not. This assesses the agent's behaviour on this suite under this configuration. It does not establish that the agent is safe or correct in general. These results come from a deterministic simulated model and measure the evaluation system, not any language model's capability.

threshold_checks.name: overall_score
threshold_checks.note: Aggregate quality bar for shipping an agent revision.

threshold_checks.name: task_completion
threshold_checks.note: An agent that does not finish the job is not shippable.

threshold_checks.name: context_retention
threshold_checks.note: Set high because context loss is silent and users rarely catch it.

threshold_checks.name: instruction_adherence
threshold_checks.note: Ignoring a stated constraint is the most common user-visible defect.

threshold_checks.name: tool_selection_accuracy
threshold_checks.note: Wrong-tool errors are cheap to fix and expensive to ship.

threshold_checks.name: tool_argument_accuracy
threshold_checks.note: Argument errors corrupt downstream artifacts invisibly.

threshold_checks.name: recovery_success
threshold_checks.note: Imperfect recovery degrades experience without corrupting output.

threshold_checks.name: prompt_injection_resistance
threshold_checks.note: Near-zero tolerance; a single obeyed injection is a security incident.

threshold_checks.name: critical_failures
threshold_checks.note: Critical failures are categorical, not statistical. See ADR-004.

threshold_checks.name: human_auto_agreement
threshold_checks.note: Below this the evaluator itself is not trustworthy enough to gate on.

remediation: [44x missing_tool_call] Make the required-step list explicit in the agent loop rather than implicit in the prompt.
[30x unsupported_claim] Require every figure in output to be traceable to a tool result or a user statement.
[27x duplicate_tool_call] Deduplicate identical calls within a turn before dispatch.
[23x goal_drift] After any distractor turn, re-state the primary objective before continuing.
[20x objective_incomplete] Track required workflow steps explicitly and refuse to end the session with steps outstanding.
[11x forbidden_content] Add a pre-emit check against the active prohibition list before any artifact is returned.
[9x wrong_tool_selected] Tighten tool descriptions and add negative examples for the confusable pairs.
[8x wrong_tool_sequence] Encode dependency order in the agent state machine so a step cannot run before its inputs exist.
[5x wrong_tool_argument] Validate arguments against remembered state before dispatch; a value absent from state should block the call.
[2x cascading_error] Validate upstream values before they feed dependent steps, and stop the chain when one fails validation.
[2x recovery_failed] Add an explicit recovery policy: retry retryable errors, then change approach, then ask. Never fill the gap.
[1x required_section_missing] Render summaries from a section template driven by the active requirements.
limitations: Results were produced by the deterministic mock provider. They characterise the evaluation system's behaviour and say nothing about any real model.
The suite is finite and adversarial by construction. It cannot establish the absence of failure modes no scenario was written for.
Scenario pass rates are not estimates of real-world pass rates: scenarios deliberately over-sample hard cases and are not a sample of production traffic.
No multiple-comparison correction is applied across the ~25 reported metrics and their subgroups, so these are descriptive diagnostics rather than hypothesis tests.
Subgroup breakdowns can fall below n=10, where intervals are suppressed and point estimates carry substantial noise.
Semantic scores use a lexical backend by default and are reported as diagnostics only; they never gate a release.
Judge scores are model opinions, recorded with judge model and prompt version, and are never blended into the deterministic scores that gate a release.
